red-wolf-dcd-de-soto.note: The campus is in Wyandotte County west of the Kansas Speedway, 600 MW proposed, six buildings, rezoned by the Unified Government. I searched the state air permit notices and permit harvest, the county and press, and the operator listings. None names a generator fleet or on-site power plant. Power is expected from Evergy.

google-kansas-city.note: Google's Kansas City campuses I could find (Northland near the airport and the Hunt Midwest park) are in Kansas City, Missouri, so air permits come from Missouri and the site belongs in a Missouri batch. I found no Google site or Kansas air permit on the Kansas side. The state's data center permit page says it has no special permits for them.

meta-kansas-city.note: Meta's Kansas City campus is the Golden Plains Technology Park in Kansas City, Missouri, so it belongs in a Missouri batch. I searched Kansas air permit notices and press and found no Meta site or generator permit on the Kansas side.

kanza-park-place-llc-emporia.note: The Flint Hills Digital Campus near Emporia names on-site generation but no fuel, unit or capacity in press or in the city zoning papers. No air permit found. Written up as a watch item with case no generation named.

sherlock-generation-llc-garden-city.note: I read the draft Kansas air construction permit (source 0550199) and its public notice. It covers up to 14 ProEnergy PE6000 natural gas simple cycle turbines of 44.5 MW each, 623 MW, which matches GEM. Backup Power no is confirmed and the permit now supplies its source.
